description: Source code for DPDK-based emulator transceiver, including receiver and transmitter classes, with methods for starting, stopping, receiving, and sending Ethernet frames, utilizing DPDK libraries and threading.

classes.name: ru_emu_dpdk_receiver
classes.description: Handles receiving Ethernet frames via DPDK, manages start/stop and receive loop.

classes.name: ru_emu_dpdk_transmitter
classes.description: Handles sending Ethernet frames via DPDK.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the DPDK Ethernet frame receiver, sets up threading and synchronization.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the receiver, waits for thread to terminate.

methods.name: receive_loop
methods.description: Main loop for receiving frames, handles stop requests and retries.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives a burst of frames from DPDK, processes each frame.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends frames in bursts, manages buffer allocation and transmission.
